articles.title: Ethereum Foundation loses another key leader as co-executive director Hsiao-Wei Wang resigns
articles.snippet: Wang's departure follows the resignation of fellow co-executive director Tomasz Stańczak and marks the latest in a string of high-profile exits at the EF.

articles.title: G7 calls for joint action on North Korean crypto theft, cybercrime
articles.snippet: G7 leaders broadened their warning over North Korean crypto theft to include wider cybercrime as researchers link DPRK-affiliated actors to billions of dollars in stolen digital assets.

articles.title: CME to Sue CFTC Over Bitcoin Perpetual Futures Approval: CEO
articles.snippet: Outgoing CME chief Terry Duffy says perpetual futures are actually swaps under Dodd-Frank, and that the exchange will file suit Thursday.
